oe_col_resettle = { # 招民垦荒
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_col_allow_calm oe_col_calm = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_col_allow_auth international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 2 } }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_col_allow_gold gold >= oe_col_cost_in }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_col_allow_slot oe_col_slot_free = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_col_allow_cd NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_act_cd } }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_col_allow_land oe_col_has_sparse = yes }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        only_color_selectable = yes
        map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
        looking_for_a = province
        source = actor
        target_flag = target
        name = "oe_col_resettle_select"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_col_resettle_none"
        column = { data = name }
        column = { data = population }
        visible = { any_location_in_province = { oe_col_sparse = yes } }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
                scope:actor = { oe_col_can_resettle = yes }
                exists = scope:target
                scope:target = { any_location_in_province = { oe_col_sparse = yes } }
            }
            custom_tooltip = oe_col_resettle_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                scope:target = { ordered_location_in_province = { limit = { oe_col_sparse = yes } order_by = oe_col_pick_score save_scope_as = oe_col_pick } }
                scope:actor = { oe_col_start = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}

            location:trebizond = { if = { limit = { oe_col_site_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } }

oe_col_close_post = { # 关闭商站
    type = internationalorganization

    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_col_allow_any_post oe_col_any_post = yes }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = location
        source = actor
        target_flag = target
        name = "oe_col_close_post_select"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_col_close_post_none"
        column = { data = name }
        column = { data = population }
        interaction_source_list = {
            location:tana = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post } add_to_list = source } }
            location:kaffa = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post } add_to_list = source } }
            location:trebizond = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post } add_to_list = source } }
            location:sinop = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post } add_to_list = source } }
            location:varna = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post } add_to_list = source } }
            location:chilia = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post } add_to_list = source } }
            location:famagusta = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post } add_to_list = source } }
            location:alexandria = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post } add_to_list = source } }
            location:beirut = { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_col_post } add_to_list = source } }
        }
        only_color_selectable = yes
        map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
        visible = { has_variable = oe_col_post }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
                exists = scope:target
                scope:target = { has_variable = oe_col_post }
            }
            custom_tooltip = oe_col_close_post_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                scope:actor = {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_close_loc value = scope:target }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_col_job value = 76 }
                    trigger_event_silently = oe_col.99
                }
            }
        }
    }
